title: Commission Deduction in Home Purchase Financing Sale Proceeds Estimates
content:
**Proceeds estimate guidance — the commission on an In-Place Home Resale package**

For a Home Purchase Financing borrower selling through Hearthstone Home Sales, the commission deduction from the sale proceeds follows the package of the In-Place Home Resale file under contract, applied to the sale price on that file:

- Where the resale package charges a commission and its commission percentage of the sale price reaches its minimum commission, the commission deduction is the commission percentage of the sale price, rounded half up to the cent.
- Where the package charges a commission and that percentage falls short of the minimum commission, the commission deduction is the minimum commission.
- Where the package charges no commission, this guidance sets no commission deduction.

"Reaches" includes equality: a percentage amount exactly equal to the minimum is taken as the percentage amount.

### Cases (hypothetical package figures, sale price 60000.00)

| Package commission percentage | Package minimum commission | Percentage amount | Commission deduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6.0 percent | 2500.00 | 3600.00 | 3600.00 |
| 3.0 percent | 2500.00 | 1800.00 | 2500.00 (the minimum) |
| no commission charged | — | — | not set by this guidance |
